verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַח I) bater palmas (em luto ou alegria).
definicoes_originais: (טָפַח I) clapping of hands (in mourning or rejoicing).
notas_originais: Y. Bets. V. 63 a ט' שהוא לרצונו tippua ḥ means a clapping which is done purposely, opp. סיפוק spontaneous clapping; M. Kat. 27 b ט' ביד tippua ḥ is done with the hands, opp. קילוס, striking of feet.—

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָפַל); enfermagem, atendimento, cuidado.; pasta higiênica, v.
notas_originais: Tosef. Nidd. II, 4 חייבת … בט' וכ' a woman is bound to nurse her child twenty four months (during which she must not remarry), whether her own &c. B. Mets. 69 a טִיפּוּלָהּ מרובה the care-taking of small cattle is more troublesome; Bekh. 26 b טִפּ'; a. e.

Pes. 42 b טִיפּוּלָן של וכ' the paste used by the daughters of rich men.— Pl. טִיפּוּלִין, constr. טִיפּוּלֵי. Y. ib. II, beg. 29 d אית תניי תני ט' some read in the Mishnah tippulé (in place of תכשיטי).
Tem. 30 a טִיפוּנֵה דכלב the excess of the value of the dog over that of any single lamb taken in exchange.

(v. טָפַח II), ט' רוחא conceitedness. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 d פלוני אינו בעולם ט' רוחיה עליה ‘the man—is not in this world’, is not a clear testimony of death, as it may be interpreted, ‘his conceit came over him’.—V. תִּיפַּח.
, v. טָפַף II
, v. טפִּיטָא
, &c., v. sub. טפש'.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cap. = h. טִיפָּה. Nidd. 20 b ט' קמייתא o primeiro gotejamento da menstruação. B. Kam. 98 a דט' דדמא וכ' ocorreu um extravasamento de uma gota de sangue em seu ouvido.
notas_originais: ch. = h. טִיפָּה. Nidd. 20 b ט' קמייתא the first dripping of menstruation. B. Kam. 98 a דט' דדמא וכ' an extravasation of a drop of blood took place in his ear.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טְקַס); = טִיכּוּס, muralha, aterro.; arranjo, medição, proporções.
notas_originais: Targ. II Kings XVI, 18 (h. text מיסך).
Targ. Jer. I, 13 טיקוס משיריתיה (v. טְקַס). Targ. Ez. XLIII, 10 (h. text תכנית). Ib. 13 (h. text גב); a. e.

טֵיקַס, טֵקַס, (preced.) banner, arrangement of troops, standard, division belonging to one standard (corresp. to h. דֶּגֶל). Targ. Num. II, 2; 3; a. fr. Y. ib. וטִיקְסֵיה וכ' and its banner was made of wool &c.— Pl. טִיקְסִין, טִיקְסַיָּא, טִקְ'. Ib. 17; a. fr.—Targ. Cant. VI, 4 ארבע טִקְסַיִךְ וכ' thy four divisions in the desert.—[Lam. R. to I, 5 טִיקְסַיָּה Ar., ed. טכס', v. טִיכְסָא].
— Pl. טִירִים, טִירִין. Macc. 10 a; Yalk. Deut. 921.
, Y. M. Kat. III, 83 c bot., בר ט', v. נְזִירָא II

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. טִירָאוֹת (v. טִירָה) lugares para augúrios, (templum).
definicoes_originais: , pl. טִירָאוֹת (v. טִירָה) places for augury, ( templum).
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 83 (play on מטרד, Gen. XXXVI, 39) שהיו מעמידין טיראות וכ' ‘Rashi’ (in ed. Wil. 1878; text טוּרָיוֹת) they put up auguries for idolatry, v. טוּר I; Yalk. ib. 140 טיריון (read: טִירָיוֹת.).
, Pesik. R. s. 10 באים עליהם ט', read: באים לעסק טירונין, v. טִירוֹן I
v. טִרְדָּא

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. XLVI, 23; טור ou נטר) guarda, trnsf. envolvente de forno, alvenaria.
definicoes_originais: v. Ez. XLVI, 23; טור or נטר) guard, trnsf. surrounding of an oven, brick-work.
notas_originais: Kel. V, 3 טִירַת התנור. Tosef. ib., B. Kam. IV, 3 חפר … להן ט' if he made a guard around them by digging in the ground. Ib. טִירַת כירה (Kel. l. c. עטרת), v. כִּירָה. Ib. הרי הן כט' (Var. corrupt קטירה) are in ritual law like &c.
, v. next w.
Lev. R. s. 18, end בו"ד גוזר ט' וכ' (not טירודא) a human authority decrees banishment, so does the Lord (to the leper). Gen. R. s. 2, beg.; Yalk. ib. 4. [Num. R. s. 7, v. טָרַד.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (tiro, τίρων) jovem soldado, trnsf. iniciante, novato.
definicoes_originais: (tiro, τίρων) young soldier, trnsf. beginner, novice.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 3, beg. ט' היה וכ' Moses was a novice in prophecy. Y. Erub. V, beg. 22 b (ref. to I Kings XVII, 1, where Elijah is for the first time mentioned as a prophet and yet says, ‘the Lord before whom I stood’) והלא אלי' ט' לנבואה היה (not טירונין לנביאים) was not Elijah at that time a novice &c.?— Pl. טִירוֹנִין. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1 לעסק ט' Ar. (ed. טרופין, corr. acc.) for the levy of soldiers; Pesik. R. s. 10 עליהם טירבוס (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. טִירוֹנִין (טוּר ou נטר, cmp. טוּרָנָא, v. טִיר) guardas de observação.
definicoes_originais: , pl. טִירוֹנִין (טוּר or נטר, cmp. טוּרָנָא, v. טִיר) guards of observation.
notas_originais: Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) ט' (expl. כרים על שערים, Ez. XXI, 27; Koh. R. to XII, 8 כרקומין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: por favor. טִירוֹנִין. Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 10 טִירוֹנֵיהוֹן (h. texto טִירֹתָם).
notas_originais: pl. טִירוֹנִין. Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 10 טִירוֹנֵיהוֹן (h. text טִירֹתָם).
— Pl. טִירוּנִין. Targ. Y. Deut. XX, 1 (synonym. with גֵּיוְתָנִין).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (tironia, uma denominação de tiron, não registrada de outra forma) recrutamento de soldados.
definicoes_originais: (tironia, a denom. of tiron, not otherwise recorded) levy of soldiers.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to II, 8; Gen. R. s. 42; s. 70 שמכתבת ט' וכ' which writes out a levy from all nations. [Ib. s. 88 שכותבת ט' Ar., ed. שמכתבת טרימוסיאה; Yalk. ib. 147 טירני, prob. a corrupt. of טְרִיבּוּטָא (tribute) tributes.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τυραννία) soberania, governo absoluto, usurpação (correspondente ao h. זְרוֹעַ).
definicoes_originais: (τυραννία) sovereignty, absolute rule, usurpation (corresp. to h. זְרוֹעַ).
notas_originais: Y. Yeb. VIII, 9 d top; Y. Kidd. IV, 65 d bot. עיקר ט' וכ' the principal designation of their (the priests’) usurpation lies in the words (Hos. IV, 4). Pesik. R. s. 15; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 52 b; Lev. R. s. 23, beg. (ref. to בזרוע, Ps. LXXVII, 16) בטר' with imperial power. Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56 d אלו שהן באין בט' לפני וכ' those who come before the Lord with power (interch. with בזרוע). Ab. Zar. 3 a אין הקב"ה בא בט'וכ' the Lord does not deal despotically with his creatures. Yalk. Deut. 945 היה עולה אצל אביו בט' (Ruth R. introd. במרוצה) came to his father with arrogance.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָרַף); (sub. הדעת) confusão, distração; dificuldade.; expulsão, banimento (cmp. טֵירוּדִין).
notas_originais: Ber. V, 4 (34 a) מפני הטי' because he might become confused (and be unable to resume his prayers); Deut. R. s. 7, beg.—Cant. R. to VIII, 13 בט' הדעת in confusion (not in concert).—Tanḥ. Mick. 2 נטרף טרוף אחד had only one trouble (about the interpretation of his dream).— Pl. טֵירוּפִין, טֵר'. Ib. נטרף שני ט' had two troubles (not knowing even the dream).—Sifré Deut. 296 (ref. to בדרך, Deut. XXV, 17) בשעת טֵיוּפֵיכֶם when you were in a state of disorder.
Gen. R. s. 15; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXIX (omitt. in ed. Bub.); Yalk. ib. 887 טֵירוּפִי מתוכה my banishment from Eden.
, v. טַרְחוּת

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טרי) o movimento de agitação do moinho.
definicoes_originais: (טרי) the shaking movement of the mill.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 18 a (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50). Ib. 20 b.—V. טַרְיָיתָא.

Sifré Num. 157; Yalk. ib. 785 (play on טירתם, Num. XXXI, 10) מקום שהיו בט' the place where they were in trouble (fear of the enemy).—[Yalk. Gen. 140, v. טִירָא.—Y. Taan. II, 66 a יום ט', v. טְרָיָינוֹס.]
, v. טִירָא
, v. טִירְיָא
, v. טִירְיָנָא
Ab. Zar. 11 b (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Y. ib. I, 39 c תִּירְיַיסְקֵי a Median festival

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pers. tiryân, Lag.; v. P. Sm. 1508) cesta.
definicoes_originais: (Pers. tiryân, Lag.; v. P. Sm. 1508) basket.
notas_originais: Pes. 88 a (Ms. M. טידיי', read טיר'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Taan. 9 b צנא).

Kerith. 9 a; (Ned. 57 b תְּרִיתָאָה; ib. 59 b תִּירְתָּאָה; Y. Peah II, 17 d תורתייה; Y. Kidd. I, 60 c bot. תִּרְתָּיָיה; Y. Ber. III, 6 d תִּרְתָּיָה).
, v. טַרְסָאָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טְרַף) documento que confere o direito de apreensão dos bens do devedor vendidos após o empréstimo, v.
definicoes_originais: (טְרַף) document conferring the right of seizure of a debtor’s property sold after the loan, v. אַדְרַכְתָּא.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 169 a כל ט' וכ' a tirpa which fails to contain the words, ‘We have torn the note of indebtedness’ &c. B. Kam. 9 a אחוי טִירְפָּךְ וכ' show thy t., and I shall pay thee. Keth. 95 a top.
v. טָפַס

Targ. Prov. XXI, 14.
Targ. Ps. XL, 3.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Teth, nome da nona letra do Alfabeto.
definicoes_originais: Teth, name of the ninth letter of the Alphabet.
notas_originais: Maas. Sh. IV, 11 טי"ת טבל Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. ט') if the vessel is marked Teth, it means Tebel (טֶבֶל). V. ט'.
, v. תַּכְתַּקָּא
, v. טִיכְנִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. דָּכַס) carimbar, pisar, pressionar.; mesmo. - Parte. passar. mesmo.; (v. próximo w.) equipar, v.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. דָּכַס) to stamp, tread upon, press.
(v. next w.) to equip, v. טָקַס.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to III, 7 [read:] היו רואין שבע מחיצות של אש טוֹכְסוֹת וכ' they saw seven partitions of fire one pressing the other; Midr. Sam. ch. XVII טונסות (corr. acc.); (Yalk. Ex. 362; Yalk. Ps. 795 נוצצות; Num. R. s. 11, Pesik. R. s. 15, Pesik. Haḥod., p. 45 a, v. כָּסַס).
—Part. pass. מְטוּכָּס filled up. Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 2 מקום מט' a filled up place, mound (v. טִיכּוּס, טִיכְסָא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pa.; pressionar, apertar, encaixar.; (correspondente a b. h. אָסַר) prender, aproveitar e carregar.

notas_originais: טַכֵּיס
Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 4 [read:] יְטַכֵּיס.

Targ. Y. Ex. XXVIII, 28. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIV, 8 (ed. Amst. טְכִיסוּ Pe.).—Part. pass. מְטַכַּס harnessed, equipped. Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 19. Targ. II Esth. VI, 10 (some ed. מִיטּ' Ithpa.), v. טְקַס.—V. טִיכּוּסָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τάξις; flexionado como uma palavra nativa, formado como עָצִיץ, como se fosse fr. טכס) ordem, ordem, ordem de batalha; arranjo.
definicoes_originais: (τάξις; inflected like a native word, formed like עָצִיץ, as if fr. טכס) order, array, order of battle; arrangement.
notas_originais: Pesik. Vayhi, p. 66 b בט' מלכים Ar. (ed. … בטכסיסי של, read: בטַכְסִיסִין, pl.) in the order in which kings go to war; Tanḥ. Bo. 4 כטקסין של וכ'; ed. Bub. ib. 4 בטכסיס מלך וכ'; Pesik R. S. 17 בטַכְסִיסֵי מלכים (pl. constr.). Cant. R. to IV, 12 בטק' המלכים in the order of a royal (regular) army. Ex. R. s. 8, end בט' הזה הבא וכ' in this consecutive order bring &c.; Tanḥ. Vaëra 9 בטקסין הזה הביא (corr. acc.). Midr. Till. to Ps. XC בט' של נבואה under the order of prophecy. Num. R. s. 15 בט' גְּדוּלָּה (not בטקסים) in the array of power (arrogating power to themselves); Tanḥ. B’haăl. 14 בטקסים גדולים (corr. acc.). Ib. B’midb. 12 יש להם טכסין מן יעקב אביהן they have a traditional order from the way their father Jacob arranged his funeral escort; ed. Bub. ib. 12 יש בידן טכסיס אביהן. Cant. R. to II, 4 טקסים של מעלה (read … ס) the heavenly array; a. v. fr.—2) (fem.) garrison. Y. Ab. Zar. I 39 c, הדא טק' דקסרין the garrison of Caesarea, v. דּוּקִים.— Pl. טַכְסִיסִין, טַקְ', constr. טַכְסִיסֵי, טַקְ'. Sabb. 31 a ט' מלכות court ceremonial. Pesik. R. s. 17, a. e., v. supra.
, v. סַטְכַּת

Taan. 3 a בטל וברוחות וכ' as to mentioning dew and winds in the prayer &c.—Ib. b טל דברכה a fructifying dew; a. fr.— Pl. טְלָלִים, טְלָלֵין. Ḥag. 12 b עליית ט' the upper chamber (store) of dews, v. אֲגָלִים. Lev. R. s. 28 ט' קשים injurious dews; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. É. XVIII, 4. Targ. O. Gen. XXVII, 28; um. frag.- Pl. טַלִּין. Targ. Y. Gen. c.; um. e.

notas_originais: Succ. 17 b ראוי לט' על וכ' Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. ליטלו) fit for a blanket over an ass.
Ber. 43 b ט' על גבי ט' patch upon patch. V. טְלָיוֹת.
Kidd. 70 b (prob. a nickname, v. בְּלָאֵי).

Targ. Ps. VII, 4 (Ms. טול'). Ib. LXII, 11 (Var. טְלִי', טִילְ'); a. fr.— Pl. טְלוּמַיָּא. Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 16 (ed. Wil. טול').

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. טְלוֹפְחִין, טְלוֹפְחֵי, טְלָפְ' (cmp. טוֹפַח); lentilhas.; (cmp. Lat. lenticula) uma calha no lagar de vinho ou óleo (h. עדשה).

notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXV, 34; a. e.—Ab. Zar. 38 b ט' דחלא, ט' דמיא lentils boiled in vinegar, … in water. Yeb. 63 b; Yalk. Koh. 976 טַפְלוֹחָאִי; a. fr.
B. Bath. 67 b, expl. יָם (v. עֲדַשָּׁה).
, Targ. II Esth. II, 7 וט' some ed., read: בטַלְיוּתָהּ, v. טַלְיוּ
אַטְלַח (= טלע) to halt. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXII, 32 (some ed. אטלע). [Targ. Y. ib. XXXVII, 2, v. טָלֵה.]
Sabb. 43 b ט' מן הצד moving a thing sideways (in an unusual manner); a. fr.
Lev. R. s. 5 (ref. to Is. XXII, 17) ט' אחר ט' repeated migration from land to land. Gen. R. s. 39 (expl. נְדֹד, B. LV, 8), v. נִדְנוּד.

Targ. Is. XXII, 17. Targ. Ps. XVIII, 19 (h. text איד).—Ib. LVI, 9 (some ed. pl.; h. text נ̇ד); a. fr.—טִלְטוּלִין, טִלְטוּלֵי, טִילְ'. Keth. 28 a (ref. to Is. XXII, 17) ט' דגברא קשין וכ' the sufferings of homelessness are harder on man than on woman; (Snh. 26 a; Yalk. Is. 280 sing.).
— Pl. טַלְטוּלִין. Targ. Lam. III, 45 (h. text סחי).
Targ. Is. III, 21 (Ar. טְלוּלַיָּא, טִילּוּלַ'; h. text נזמי האף).

Gen. R. s. 39 טַלְטֵל עצמך וכ' banish thyself (travel) from place to place. Ib. s. 38 (expl. הניעמו, Ps. LIX, 12) טַלְטְלֵימוֹ make them exiles. Y. Peah I, 15 d top (expl. נעו, Prov. V, 6) טי' הקב"ה מתן וכ' the Lord made unsteady (irregular) the reward of the observants, that they might observe the commands in faith. Num. R. s. 10 (ed. Amst. p. 238 a) שהן מְטַלְטְלִין דעתו וכ' they (carnal pleasures) confound man’s judgment (cmp. טָרַף).—Part. pass. מְטוּלְטָל, f. מְטוּלְטֶלֶת. Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Sh’mini 7 והדעת מט' and the mind becomes confused.—
נִתְטַלְטֵל, נִיטַּ'

Sabb. l. c. כל הנרות מִטַּלְטְלִין all lamps may be handled. Ib. 35 a מעיין הַמִיטַּלְטֵל a travelling spring (changing its place). Gen. R. s. 39. Sifra Sh’mini ch. VII, Par. 6 מִטַּלְטְלִין במלואם are carried with their contents; Kel. XV, 1 עשויין לִיטַּלְטֵל וכ'. Yalk. Prov. 964; Midr. Prov. to XXX, 27 Alexander the Macedonian שנ' בכל וכ' who in his unrest drove all over the world like a locust &c.; a. fr.—V. מִטַּלְטְלִין.
Tanḥ. Sh’mini 5 נִתְטַלְטְלָה דעתו וכ' his mind is confused, and he knows not what he is talking &c. Ib. כדי שלא תִטַּלְטֵל דעתו in order that he may not get mixed up; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טלל) capa, lençol, manto (semelhante ao pálio romano, gr. φᾶρος).
definicoes_originais: (טלל) cover, sheet, cloak (similar to the Roman pallium, Gr. φᾶρος).
notas_originais: Sabb. 147 a ט' מקופלת a cloak folded up and thrown over the shoulder. Men. 41 a ט' כפולה a double-sized sheet worn by doubling it. Sabb. 138 a ט' כפולה וכ' one must not make a tent on the Sabbath by spreading a double-sized sheet on poles so that the ends hang down. Kidd. 18 a sq. (ref. to בבגדו, Ex. XXI, 8) כיון שפירש טַלִּיתוֹ עליה since he spread his (bed-) sheet over her (v. בָּגַד).—Esp. Tallith, the cloak of honor, the scholar’s or officer’s distinction (adorned with fringes according to Num. XV, 38 sq.); the cloak of the leader in prayer. Num. R. s. 8, end שמלה זו ט' simlah (Deut. X, 18), that means the cloak to which the show-fringes are attached. Gen. R. s. 36 (ref. to השמלה, Gen. IX, 23) לפיכך זכה שם לט' וכ' therefore was Shem privileged to wear the Tallith &c. Ex. R. s. 27 נתמנה … ונטל ט' וכ' when one has been appointed to an office and has taken the T., he must not &c.; a. fr.— Pl. טַלִּיתוֹת, טַלִּיּוֹת. Sabb. 147 a ed. (Ms. M. sing.). Tanḥ. Korah 2; Num. R. s. 18, beg. ט' תכלת cloaks all of purple blue; Y. Snh. X, 27 d bot. טלויות, ed. Krot. טלוי' (corr. acc. or טַלִּיוֹת). Zab. IV, 5 עשר טליות וכ' if ten sheets are placed above one another. Ib. 7; Sabb. 93 a
Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 26 (ed. Amst. טָלֵית, Var. טַלֵּת).
Koh. R. to IX, 5 טַלִּיתֵיה (Ber. 18 a תכלתיה). Ib. טלי טַלִּיתָיךְ, v. טְלֵי.

Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIV, 4 (ed. Amst. טַלְיָ'); a. fr.—Yeb. 114 a, v. טָלֵי.—Y. ib. XII, 12 d bot. היא ט' וכ' if she is young and he old. Lam. XXXI, 15; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: to hang over, (of liquids) to form drops; v. טַל.
notas_originais: — Part. pass. טָלוּל, f. טְלוּלָה a) hanging. Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44 a bot. [read:] שלא היתה שם טיפה אחת ט' that there should not have been there (in the vat) one drop hanging (which drops down on being touched or shaken). b) (with שנה, denom. of טַל) blessed with dew. Taan. 24 b; Y. Yoma V, 42 c top.; Lev. R. s. 20; Tanḥ. Aḥăre 3; ed. Bub. ib. 4, v. גָּשַׁם.

notas_originais: טַלֵּיל to make a טְלָלָא; to cover, screen. Targ. I Kings VI, 9 (h. text ספן). Targ. Y. Ex. XL, 21 (O. Af ; h. text ויסך). Ib. XXV, 20 מְטַלְלִין (O. מַטְּלִין); a. fr.—Succ. 31 a (a beam) דגזלה ומְטַלֵּל עלה Ms. M. (ed. דגזולה only) which one stole and put upon it the covering of the Succah, v. מְטַלַּלְתָּא.— Part. pass. מְטַלַּל, f. מְטַלְּלָא. B. Kam. 50 b משום דמט' because the cave is roofed. Ib. דלא מְטַלְּלֵי which are uncovered.—Trnsf. to obscure. Sabb. 78 a מסו ומְטַלְּלֵי they heal (the eye-sore) but dim the eye-sight.

Targ. Ps. XXVII, 5; a. fr.—Ber. 19 a נפל קניא מט' (Ms. M. משמי ט') a reed fell down from the ceiling. Ib. 48 a אחוי לשמי ט' pointed up to the ceiling. B. Kam. 66 b מעיקרא כשורא והשתא ט' formerly it was named beam, now ceiling, v. מָרֵישׁ.— Pl. טְלָלַיָּא. Targ. Job XL, 21, sq. (h. text צאלים).

definicoes_originais: to bend, press, esp. (corresp. to h. עָשַׁק) to take undue advantage of, to oppress.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. V, 21. Targ. Ps. CXIX, 122; a. fr.—Part. pass. טְלִים, (טְלוּם). Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 33. Targ. Ps. CIII, 6 (some ed. incorr. טָלוֹ'); a. e.—Lev. R. s. 12 (ref. to Prov. XXIII, 35) טָלְמִין ליה וכ' they overcharge him (in his drunkenness), and he knows it not &c.
